headline: As of 2026-11-11: 74,134,797 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+4.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 74,134,797 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+4.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (11,308,974), Florida (8,117,210), Texas (7,917,561).
